name: rosetta-split-a-character-string-based-on-change-of-character
code:
use default

split(text: string) -> LIST[string] is
    let runs = LIST()

    let start mut = 0

    for at in 1::text.length do
        if at == text.length \/ text[at] != text[start] then
            runs.add(text[start..at])

            start = at
        fi
    od

    runs
si

write_line(split("gHHH5YY++///\\") |> Ghul.Pipes.join(", "))
